summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting that the High Court of Justice of England and Wales approved its statutory scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the Companies Act 2006. The scheme had been approved by shareholders on May 21, 2026. Under the scheme, each Marex ordinary share will be cancelled and holders will receive one ordinary share of New Marex, a Bermuda exempted company that will become the new parent holding company (the Redomiciliation). The effective date is expected to be July 1, 2026. Last trading of Marex shares on Nasdaq is expected to be June 30, 2026. There is no price per share, premium, or consideration change. The filing represents a corporate redomiciliation, not a standard special situation category.
